facts.fact: Raxio's CIV1 colocation facility in Abidjan was inaugurated in September 2024 and is in service, with the Ministry of Digital Transition signing an MoU to use it.
Connecting Africa describes Raxio CIV1 in Abidjan as a Tier 3-certified carrier-neutral colocation facility (2,000 sq m, up to 800 racks, 3MW); certifier not named; as_of is the article date.
